n: Lyman Sherman, a member of the Seventy, came to Joseph Smith asking for the Lord’s word. The Lord forgives his sins because he obeyed the prompting to come and seek counsel from the prophet.

f.g: Lyman R. Sherman, one of the first presidents of the Seventy.

n: He can be at peace about his standing before God—and should stop resisting the Lord’s voice.

f.w: let your soul be at rest

n: He should be more careful to keep his vows, and he will receive great blessings.

f.g: Solemn promises or covenants made to God.

n: He should wait patiently for the solemn assembly, when he will be remembered with the first elders and ordained with them.

f.g: Held in the Kirtland Temple in March 1836.

n: This is the Father’s promise, if he stays faithful.
From that day he will have authority to preach wherever the Lord sends him.
So he should strengthen his brethren in everything—his conversation, prayers, encouragement, and actions.

f.g: In older English, one’s whole manner of life and conduct, not just speech.

n: The Lord is with him to bless and deliver him forever.
